cards.entity: The film about the Donner Party
cards.claim: The format of the film about the Donner Party is a documentary.
cards.quote: The Donner Party (1992 film) The Donner Party is a 1992 documentary film that traces the history of the Donner Party, an ill-fated pioneer group that trekked from Springfield, Illinois to Sutter's Fort, California - a disastrous journey of 2500 miles made famous by the tales of cannibalism the survivors told upon reaching their destination.
